subtitle: Lesson 13 · Data Protection & Encryption

eyebrow: The problem: cloning production for dev and test
code:
Production clone, as-is:
Jane Martinez, jane.martinez@acme.com, 555-0142

Every developer, tester, and contractor touching
that sub-production instance now sees real PII
they never needed in the first place.
caption: Nobody writing a test script needs a real phone number.

eyebrow: Anonymization: realistic fake data, in place of the real thing
code:
Anonymization replaces real values with
fake-but-realistic-looking data:
same shape, same formats, plausible values
that are not any real person's information.
caption: The clone still looks and behaves like production data.

eyebrow: And that replacement is permanent, by design
code:
Before anonymization:                  After anonymization:
Jane Martinez                          Pat Alvarez
jane.martinez@acme.com      ->         pat.alvarez@example.net
555-0142                               555-0198
(real customer data)                   (fake, realistic, permanent)
caption: The original value is gone from that instance for good.

eyebrow: Masking: hidden, but preserved, by role
code:
Same real field value: 123-45-6789

Role WITHOUT unmask permission:        Role WITH unmask permission:
***-**-6789                            123-45-6789
(masked; real value unchanged)         (full real value, authorized)
caption: The underlying value is never destroyed or altered.
